page.overview:
Who is Lightning's Final Fantasy XIII-2 battle quotes?

Lightning is a party member in Final Fantasy XIII-2, either as a tutorial character in the prologue, as a DLC-exclusive character in Lightning's Story: Requiem of the Goddess scenario and as a Paradigm Pack "monster". She utters various lines of dialogue when commanded during battle, depending on the situation on hand.

Forgotten time be reborn! —First battle's opening line.

Now! Settle this! Take this! Can you handle this?! Cutting you down. —Attacking in first battle.

Fulfill your oath! Be my shield! —Ullr's Shield
